expectations.text: Advises starting coarser / not pre-splitting the three phases into many tiny files
expectations.evidence: Net recommendation is MORE structure up front — csv/, jobs/, status/ subfolders each with multiple files (generate-csv.ts, serializers.ts, create-export-job.ts, run-export-job.ts, job-store.ts...). The 'don't over-build day one' caveat is secondary and uses a ~200-line scan-comfort heuristic.

expectations.text: Co-locates tightly coupled job lifecycle / polling
expectations.evidence: Keeps enqueue/worker/status-read as wired pieces and suggests usePollExportStatus hook owning interval/backoff.

expectations.text: Recommends an abstraction (hook/module) over bare file splits
expectations.evidence: Suggests usePollExportStatus hook and a trigger-agnostic run-export-job(jobId) module boundary.

expectations.text: Mentions a ~300-line threshold as the split trigger
expectations.evidence: Uses ~200 lines as a scan-comfort cue, and frames structure type-first rather than size-driven; no ~300-line signal-to-noise threshold.
